summary: Private deployment: request for upgrade bundle release notes + model deprecation timeline (offline export)
content:
Issue Summary
Northbridge (Private / on-prem, air-gapped) is requesting:
1) Upgrade bundle release notes that are shipped with each offline upgrade artifact (machine-readable + human-readable).
2) A clear model deprecation timeline/policy for their pinned model versions, including what “deprecated” means operationally and what happens to older versions in Private.

They are blocked on internal change-management approval until they can attach release notes + deprecation guidance to their CAB (Change Advisory Board) ticket.

Impact
- Customer CAB requires release notes for every software + model change.
- Current Private upgrade bundle includes platform version notes but not a per-model/version changelog.
- Customer security/compliance is asking for a predictable deprecation window for model variants.

Customer ask (verbatim excerpt from TAM notes)
“We need release notes packaged with the upgrade bundle (PDF or HTML is fine) that enumerate: platform changes + any model version promotions, including deprecations. We also need a deprecation timeline we can point auditors to. We cannot consume a public web page due to the air-gapped environment.”

Environment
- Deployment mode: Private / on-prem (air-gapped)
- Upgrade workflow: offline bundle delivered via secure file exchange; customer installs via their internal pipeline
- Redwood Console access: limited (customer doesn’t allow outbound web access from the cluster)

What we checked
- Public docs release notes exist for some platform changes; model promotions are not consistently represented.
- Console release notes feed is not accessible in their air-gapped environment.
- We do not yet export a “release notes artifact” as part of Private upgrade bundles.

Steps to reproduce (support)
1) Generate/ship a standard Private upgrade bundle.
2) Observe included docs: platform upgrade notes only.
3) No attached model/version changelog; no deprecation timeline statement included.

Requested deliverables (customer)
- For each upgrade bundle: a single release notes document + a machine-readable changelog file.
- For each served model: current version, previous version (if applicable), change category (breaking/perf/quality/bugfix/security/deprecation), rollback guidance, and deprecation dates.

Internal Notes / Triage
- This aligns with ongoing work for model metadata schema + changelog generator.
- We should avoid exposing internal-only notes or sensitive details in customer-facing artifacts.
- Need to confirm what we can commit to on deprecation timelines for Private (they often remain supported longer due to customer-controlled upgrade cadence).

Comments
2025-10-09 10:14 (Miguel Santos, Reporter)
Opened per Northbridge CAB block. They need an offline artifact attached to each upgrade bundle. They also asked for an explicit deprecation timeline for pinned model versions.

2025-10-09 12:02 (Dev Patel, Assignee)
Acknowledged to TAM. Asked Northbridge to confirm:
- Which bundle version they are upgrading to and target date
- Whether they need per-region details (their install appears single-site)
- Preferred format (PDF/HTML/Markdown + JSON)

2025-10-10 09:18 (Miguel Santos)
Customer response:
- Upgrade planned week of 10/21
- Single-site
- Preferred: PDF for CAB packet + JSON for internal tracking
- They specifically want deprecation dates or a stated “minimum notice window.”

2025-10-10 11:40 (Dev Patel)
Looped in Kira Thompson (Private/Dedicated docs) and Connor O’Brien (Release Eng) for interim approach. Also pinged Marissa Cole re: deprecation policy language.

2025-10-11 15:27 (Internal note, Dev Patel)
Proposed interim workaround:
- Generate a one-off “bundle release notes” document (PDF + JSON) manually using:
  - model registry current/pinned versions (from internal admin view)
  - recent model promotion events (last 90 days)
  - platform upgrade notes from release train
- Include a deprecation policy statement: “Private customers will receive a minimum of 180 days notice before a model version is removed from support in new Private bundles; previously shipped bundles remain usable.”
Pending PM approval on exact wording.

2025-10-12 10:05 (Connor O’Brien)
Confirmed we can export a deterministic artifact from our internal changelog generator outputs once ENG-9829 lands. For now, we can produce a signed PDF + JSON from current generator staging output and attach to the customer’s bundle delivery.

2025-10-12 13:42 (Kira Thompson)
Drafted a short “Private upgrade bundle release notes” template:
- Executive summary (what changed)
- Model changes (new/updated/deprecated)
- Risk notes (breaking/behavioral changes)
- Rollback instructions
- Deprecation policy (notice window)
- Contact + escalation
Needs Security review for redaction boundaries.

2025-10-13 09:30 (Marissa Cole)
Approved using “minimum 180-day notice” language for deprecation in Private, with the caveat:
- The clock starts at first written notice to the customer (release notes + email from TAM), and
- Exceptions possible for critical security issues (rare; handled via direct comms).
Do not promise exact dates for every model yet; provide “earliest removal” date where known.

2025-10-13 14:10 (Dev Patel)
Sent Northbridge an interim CAB packet draft (PDF) + JSON changelog extract via secure channel (per TAM). Included:
- Platform version notes for the bundle
- Model changes since their last bundle (as best-effort)
- Deprecation policy statement (180-day minimum notice)
Asked them to validate if the granularity is sufficient.

2025-10-14 16:55 (Miguel Santos)
Customer confirmed the packet unblocks CAB submission. They requested that future bundles include this automatically.

2025-10-15 09:08 (Internal note, Dev Patel)
Follow-ups captured:
- Product/Eng: ensure Private upgrade bundle exports include release notes artifacts (PDF/HTML + JSON). Map to planned work item: ENG-9829-private-upgrade-bundle-release-note-export.
- Docs: add a dedicated section in Private deployment docs explaining where release notes live and how to interpret deprecation timelines.
- Security: confirm redaction rules for offline artifacts match public vs internal field strategy.

Resolution
Provided an interim offline release notes packet (PDF) and a machine-readable JSON changelog extract for the customer’s upcoming Private upgrade. Published internally approved deprecation policy language (minimum 180-day notice for model version support removal in new Private bundles, with limited security exceptions).

Workaround / Next steps
- Workaround delivered: manual export for this upgrade.
- Planned product improvement: automate export of release notes artifacts into Private upgrade bundles (tracked in ENG-9829).

Customer-facing notes (what we told them)
- We will include upgrade release notes as part of future offline bundles.
- We will provide a minimum 180-day notice before removing support for a model version from future Private bundles, except for rare critical security cases handled via direct coordination.

Attachments (stored in internal support drive; not attached to Jira)
- Northbridge_CAB_Packet_Redwood_Private_Upgrade_2025-10-13.pdf
- northbridge_upgrade_changelog_extract_2025-10-13.json
